$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[0].title: Protection
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[0].funde: At your age a serious illness or injury is far more likely than death. This pays a lump sum to live on while you recover.
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[0].notYe: Cashbuilder II with disability income rider
The rider pays a monthly income if illness or injury stops you working. The plan locks in lifelong cover while you are young and healthy, and builds cash value.
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[0].note: Your safe range is $64 to $128. We plan to $200, the amount you chose, and fund plans in priority order. Not yet: Cashbuilder II with disability income rider (needs about $300 a month). Add it when the budget grows.
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[1].title: Savings plans
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[1].funde: Starting in your 20s is the biggest money advantage you will ever have. An unregistered plan is easier to reach if life changes.
Forced saving for a set date, such as a house deposit or a car, with life cover built in.
$.renter.insuranceBudget.groups[1].note: About 10% of take-home, once your emergency fund is full.
$.renter.insuranceBudget.note: A budget, not a quote. Kyron turns it into real prices, and checks what fits your health and your goals.
